name: Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic (1931–1937)
description: A red field with a yellow hammer and sickle and star in the upper hoist beside the republic's initials 'A.S.Ş.C.' in yellow Latin letters.
history: Flag of the Azerbaijan SSR from 1931 with the initials in Latin script only, following the alphabet reform of the late 1920s. It was replaced under the 1937 constitution, adopted after Azerbaijan became a union republic in its own right in 1936.
